# TASK-079 — specification

## Scope

ArchUnitTS architecture rules for backend and frontend (`tests/archunit.test.ts`): dependency direction between web, API, shared, publisher, agent runner and scripts; components independent of views; production code independent of tests; no import cycles with type imports included; PascalCase views and components, kebab-case modules; file size budgets; slices adhere to `docs/architecture/components.puml`. Removing the type-level cycles moved `Auth` to `apps/api/src/auth-types.ts` and the library authoring types to `packages/shared/src/template-types.ts`. `pnpm arch:graph` writes the dependency graph (Mermaid, HTML).
